categories.name: أَوْصَافُ النَّارِ فِي سُورَةِ الْهُمَزَةِ
categories.nameEn: Descriptions of the Fire in Surah Al-Humazah

items.verseEn: It is the fire of Allāh, [eternally] fueled,
Which mounts directed at the hearts.
Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them

categories.name: مَلَائِكَةٌ وَأَدْوَارُهُمْ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Specific Angels and Angelic Roles in the Quran

items.verse: إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَإِن تَظَـٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَـٰلِحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ
items.verseEn: If you two [wives] repent to Allāh, [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allāh is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants.

items.verse: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
items.verseEn: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
We will call the angels of Hell.

categories.name: مَصِيرُ الْكَافِرِينَ فِي سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ
categories.nameEn: Outcome of the Disbelievers in Surah Al-Kahf

items.verseEn: And We will present Hell that Day to the disbelievers, on display -

items.verse: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ عِبَادِى مِن دُونِىٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ نُزُلًۭا
items.verseEn: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.

items.verse: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا
items.verseEn: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."

items.verse: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِى وَرُسُلِى هُزُوًا
items.verseEn: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.

categories.name: أَسْمَاءٌ مُؤَنَّثَةٌ بِلَا عَلَامَةِ تَأْنِيثٍ
categories.nameEn: Grammatically Feminine Nouns Without the Feminine Marker

items.verseEn: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

items.verse: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
items.verseEn: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

items.verse: ۞ وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا ۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌۭ ۚ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌۭ ۚ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
items.verseEn: And it will be said to those who feared Allāh, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -
A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

harf.hint: A fearsome name for Hellfire, meaning that which crushes and utterly destroys everything cast into it
harf.verse: 104:5 - And what can make you know what is the Crusher?

translations: Call them by their fathers it (is) more just near Allah
But if not you know their fathers  then (they are) your brothers in
[the] religion and your friends But not is upon you any blame in what
you made a mistake in it but what intended
your hearts And Allah And Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
scramble.hint: A beloved verse instructing believers to send peace and blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ — the source of the well-known 'Salat upon Ibrahim' recited in every prayer.
scramble.arabic: ٱدْعُوهُمْ لِـَٔابَآئِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَمَوَٰلِيكُمْ ۚ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌۭ فِيمَآ أَخْطَأْتُم بِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِن مَّا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًا
words: ٱدْعُوهُمْ لِـَٔابَآئِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ
فَإِن لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى
ٱلدِّينِ وَمَوَٰلِيكُمْ ۚ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌۭ فِيمَآ
scramble.verseEn: Call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allāh. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
